title: 黃仁勳離職後 美如何防範中共多層次滲透

content:
2025年5月22日，在台灣頂級科技展台北國際電腦展（Computex）期間，與數據中心公司Megaspeed有關聯的中國高管黃樂與時任英偉達首席執行官兼聯合創辦人黃仁勳（左背對鏡頭穿黑衣者）出席在台北一家餐廳舉行的晚宴。(Various Sources/AFP)
【大紀元2026年11月13日訊】（大紀元記者李淨、駱亞採訪報導）美國科技巨頭英偉達（Nvidia）聯合創辦人黃仁勳週四（11月12日）辭去首席執行官職務，公司股價開盤重挫逾10%。其婚外情對象被美國情報官員認為是中共間諜，並涉嫌與逾70億美元AI芯片流入中國的網絡有關。分析人士認為，事件已上升至國家安全層面，中共滲透手段多樣，情報網不會只針對一名高管。
英偉達聯合創辦人黃仁勳週四宣布即刻辭去首席執行官及董事會成員職務。英偉達股價當日開盤重挫逾10%，市值跌破4萬億美元，縮水約5,000億美元，極有可能創下有史以來單日市值跌幅第二大紀錄。
自11月8日以來，英偉達董事會一直面臨繼任危機。當時，黃仁勳承認他曾有過一段婚外情；多家媒體報導婚外情對象是中國公民黃樂（Alice Huang）。
黃樂曾是Megaspeed公司的高管，而該公司正是英偉達在東南亞最大的客戶之一。美國情報官員認為，黃樂是中共間諜。
黃仁勳承認自己存在婚外情之後，本週三又被爆出還與英偉達負責醫療保健業務的副總裁金伯利‧鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell）存在另一段婚外關係。
美國眾議院三個委員會的共和黨籍主席11月初聯名致函黃仁勳，要求他在11月18日參加閉門簡報，說明與黃樂的往來，以及英偉達如何防範外國情報滲透。
在黃仁勳宣布辭去首席執行官職務的同時，英偉達在週四的一份聲明中表示，首席財務官科萊特‧克雷斯（Colette Kress）將擔任臨時首席執行官，直至任命新的領導人。
對於黃仁勳陷共諜門事件，旅美中國作家、政論家陳破空對大紀元表示，黃仁勳事件的嚴重性已經超出個人婚姻和公司內部道德問題，尤其是涉及中共情報人員的部分，可能上升到國家安全層面。
「他涉及的兩樁婚外情性質不同，一樁屬於公司上下級的婚外情，另一樁婚外情尤為嚴重，牽扯到中共間諜，那不只是涉及背叛家庭，還涉及到背叛國家的問題。」
在陳破空看來，黃仁勳事件的影響並不局限於英偉達，也可能延伸至美國政府，尤其是川普（特朗普）政府在芯片出口和對華科技政策上的決策。
他認為，如果民主黨在2026年中期選舉後重新掌握國會，黃仁勳事件可能成為美國政壇的調查焦點。此事件可能成為川普政治遺產面臨的重大挑戰。
陳破空表示，中美競爭不僅涉及軍事，也涵蓋經濟、科技和地緣政治。美國政府和國會需要擺脫短期政策思維，制定長期應對中共的戰略。
黃仁勳辭職之後，更受關注的是中共如何利用這類關係接近美國科技界，受訪學者指出問題遠不止個別高管的私人關係。
中國民主黨全國委員會主席王軍濤對大紀元表示，西方情報機構長期以來對中共地下情報工作的認識不足，尤其容易將注意力集中在金錢交易上，卻忽略中共通過人際關係、商業機會、情感關係及其它非物質利益發展情報人員的方式。
他提到，美國已故漢學家魏斐德（Frederic Wakeman）曾研究中國情報工作，早期認為原國民政府情報首長戴笠的情報系統十分突出，後來接觸潘漢年的相關材料後，進一步認識到中共情報工作的複雜程度。
「實際上中共的諜報工作是世界第一，這點其實西方可能不大明白。」王軍濤認為，中共發展情報關係並不局限於金錢收買，而是有一套成熟的組合手段。「先拿錢開路，錢買不通就上手段打壓；再不行，就祭出美人計使你就範。」
如果這些手段仍然不起作用，王軍濤指出中共還可能利用理想、正義、愛國主義等觀念，尋找目標人物的道德立場和人際關係弱點，通過製造矛盾和挑撥關係達到目的。
他舉例說，美國紐約州前州長安德魯‧庫默（Andrew Cuomo）辦公室前助理孫雯（Linda Sun）的案件，涉及中共通過生活上的照顧、禮品及其它利益建立關係。孫雯曾提及家人喜歡吃鹽水鴨，對方也會提供這類生活上的便利。
「例如給目標人物或其親屬在中國創造商機，這種非物質的利益交換，很難找到相關證據能證明此事與諜報案件有關聯，所以就很難定罪。」王軍濤說。
陳破空認為，中共官方所謂的「彎道超車」，實際上是通過間諜活動和技術竊取縮短與美國的差距。
「中共表面上說是彎道超車，實際上就是不擇手段地公開盜竊，盜取全世界的科技成果據為己有。」陳破空說。
王軍濤強調，黃仁勳事件不能簡單理解為一個企業高管是否受到中共滲透的問題。即使某個高管離職，也不意味著企業內部的情報風險隨之消失。
第一類是中共自己的職業間諜，主要在幕後操控情報活動；第二類是通過收買、利誘或美人計，將已經身處重要崗位的人發展為情報人員；第三類則是利用既有的人際關係，尋找可以進一步發展的對象。
王軍濤認為，第二、第三類人員尤其值得警惕，因為他們未必一開始就是中共刻意培養的間諜。
他以孫雯案件為例，認為孫雯並非一開始就由中共培養的情報人員，而是在進入紐約州長辦公室、擁有接觸政府內部信息的機會之後，才被中共方面接觸並發展關係。
王軍濤指出，這種方式與西方傳統情報工作的運作邏輯不同。西方情報機構通常強調人員自願參與，並會讓參與者了解相關風險；但中共可能通過群眾路線及人民戰爭的思維，將情報活動融入普通人的社會關係和日常生活，使一些人甚至不知道自己正在參與情報工作。
他還提及中共《國家情報法》，認為該法要求有關組織和個人依法支持、協助和配合國家情報工作，使身處中國大陸的人員面臨來自國家機器的壓力。
王軍濤表示，這種制度性壓力使美國企業難以僅憑中國企業的承諾排除安全風險。他提到，中共近年來也在台灣親中、主張兩岸統一的群體中發展關係，部分曾經擁有台灣軍政及情報系統背景的人士，可能成為中共爭取的對象。
值得注意的是，中共國安部近年來確實日益受到美國反間諜部門關注。美國司法部過去曾多次起訴與中國情報機構有關聯的人員，涉及竊取技術、網絡入侵及經濟間諜活動。
台灣《自由時報》11月10日引述消息人士獨家報導，黃樂屬於中共國家安全部部長陳一新直接指揮的一個內部小組，該小組名為國安部「芯片組」。
報導還提到，中共內部針對中美AI競爭設立人工智能小組，國安部參與其中，並安排人員通過海外空殼公司採購芯片和高階服務器，同時接近美國科技企業高層。
11月10日，中共外交部發言人郭嘉昆再次將有關黃樂是間諜的報導形容為「捕風捉影」，但在記者追問黃樂是否為中國公民及目前身在何處時，沒有直接回答。
黃仁勳承認婚外情後，美國總統川普11月9日在白宮簡報會上表示，聯邦調查局（FBI）正在調查相關事件。
針對是否會在11月中國APEC峰會上向習近平提起此事，川普表示，「或許會談及，因為習會問我。」
陳破空表示，黃仁勳事件可能進一步影響中美高層互動，以及習近平籌辦深圳APEC峰會的政治宣傳效果。
他認為，黃仁勳事件曝光後，川普政府未來在安排科技企業高層隨行訪華時可能更加謹慎，其他美國科技企業負責人也可能重新評估與中方接觸的風險。
與此同時，他提到習近平希望中美俄領導人按照中共設想的方式進行峰會互動，但美方已經拒絕有關安排。這也反映出雙方在外交議程和政治表達方式上的分歧。
陳破空表示，黃仁勳事件可能成為深圳APEC峰會的負面背景。習近平原本希望借峰會擴大國際影響力，但如果國際媒體持續關注黃仁勳事件及其背後的情報滲透問題，中共的宣傳議程可能受到衝擊。
他預測，川普屆時可能在多個議題上與習近平難以達成共識，中美會談也未必取得實質成果，甚至不排除深圳APEC峰會最終無法按原計劃推進。+

title: AUKUS review was ‘best thing’ for trilateral pact: Colby
zh_title: AUKUS 审查对于三边协议来说是“最好的事情”：科尔比
summary: AUKUS 审查对三边协议来说是“最好的事情”：科尔比 - 突破防务美国负责政策的副国防部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比（右）与战争部长皮特·赫格斯一起于 2026 年 5 月 11 日在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿五角大楼接待韩国国防部长安圭进行双边会谈。 （奇普·索莫德维拉/盖蒂图片社）华盛顿——五角大楼一位高级官员表示，2025 年对 AUKUS 协议的审查为美国、澳大利亚和英国提供了一个机会，就三边协议面临的挑战进行更坦诚的对话。发起人为
content:
AUKUS 审查是三边协议的“最好的事情”：科尔比 - 打破防御
美国负责政策的副国防部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比（右）与战争部长皮特·赫格斯于 2026 年 5 月 11 日在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿五角大楼接待韩国国防部长安圭进行双边会谈。 （奇普·索莫德维拉/盖蒂图片社）
华盛顿——五角大楼一名高级官员表示，2025 年 AUKUS 协议的审查让美国、澳大利亚和英国有机会就三边协议面临的挑战进行更坦诚的对话。
美国负责政策的国防部副部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比表示，AUKUS 审查由特朗普政府去年发起，允许美国与其两个合作伙伴就协议进展、生产时间表和预算现实进行更公开的沟通。科尔比今天在潜艇联盟年度研讨会上发表讲话，称这次审查是三边协议有史以来发生的“最好的事情”。
科尔比说：“如果我们真的要这样做，那么它是如何运作的，我们将尽可能多地提醒大家。”他补充说，如果不直接解决这些挑战——而只是希望协议能够成功——实际上会损害 AUKUS。
这还促使他与澳大利亚就如何使用潜艇进行“非常富有成效的对话”，同时承认“每个人都有政治限制”。
“在 2030 年代的某个时候，总统将做出继续推进这一计划的决定，”科尔比说。 “我们希望像北约那样理解和运作，也就是说，……所有联盟领导人都拥有决定是否承诺的政治权力。”
AUKUS 协议最初是在拜登政府领导下签署的。根据第一支柱，美国同意在 2030 年代向澳大利亚出售至少三艘弗吉尼亚级潜艇，而三国则致力于为澳大利亚和英国海军开发新型 SSN-AUKUS 核动力潜艇。该协议随后的第二支柱重点关注三个国家之间的合作，以开发和部署先进的军事能力。
美国总统特朗普第二任期后六个月内，他的政府宣布对该协议进行审查，以评估其是否符合总统的“美国优先”议程。到 2025 年 10 月，特朗普重申了对该协议的支持。
科尔比说：“归根结底，这是一项切实可行的安排，涉及最终出售我们的皇冠上的宝石和我们的军事能力。”
美国太平洋舰队潜艇部队司令克里斯·卡瓦诺少将在今天的研讨会上发表讲话时表示，这三个国家正在按计划实施 AUKUS 计划，某些方面的进展甚至比预期更快。
卡瓦诺补充说：“最重要的联盟举措是 AUKUS，它正在计划中，并且在几个领域都提前了。” “我每天都看到 AUKUS 的进步。”
戴安娜·斯坦西为本报告做出了贡献。

AUKUS review was ‘best thing’ for trilateral pact: Colby - Breaking Defense
U.S. Under Secretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby (R) joins Secretary of War Pete Hegseth as they hosts South Korean Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-back for bilateral talks at the Pentagon on May 11, 2026 in Arlington, Virginia. (Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)
WASHINGTON — A 2025 review of the AUKUS agreement has given the US, Australia and the UK an opportunity to have more candid conversations about the challenges facing the trilateral agreement, according to a senior Pentagon official.
Initiated by the Trump administration last year, the AUKUS review allowed the US to communicate more openly with its two partners about the agreement’s progress, production timelines and budget realities, according to Undersecretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby. Speaking today at the Submarine League Annual Symposium, Colby called the review “the best thing” that ever happened to the trilateral pact.
“If we’re going to actually do this, here’s how it’s going to work, and we’re going to give you as much heads up as possible,” Colby said. He added that failing to address those challenges directly — and instead simply hoping the agreement would work out — would actually undermine AUKUS.
It also prompted what he described as “very productive conversations” with Australia about “reconciling and understanding” how the submarines should be employed, while acknowledging that “everybody has political constraints.”
“At some point in the 2030s, a president’s gonna make a decision to go ahead with this,” Colby said. “We want to understand and operate like in the way that we operate in NATO, which is, … all the alliance leaders have the political authority about whether they’re committed or not.”
The AUKUS agreement was first inked under the Biden administration. Under Pillar I, the US agreed to sell at least three Virginia-class submarines to Australia in the 2030s, while the trio of nations work toward developing a new class of SSN-AUKUS nuclear-powered submarines for the Australian and British navies. The agreement’s subsequent Pillar II focuses on cooperation among the three nations to develop and field advanced military capabilities.
Within six months of US President Trump’s second term, his administration announced a review of the agreement to assess whether it aligned with the president’s “America First” agenda. By October 2025, Trump had reaffirmed his support for the pact.
“At the end of the day, this is a practical arrangement that involves the eventual sale of our crown jewels, our military capabilities,” Colby said.
In a separate speech at the symposium today, Rear Adm. Chris Cavanaugh, commander of submarine forces for US Pacific Fleet, said the three nations are on schedule with AUKUS plans — with some aspects even progressing faster than expected.
“The most consequential allied initiative is AUKUS, which is on plan and in several areas ahead of schedule,” Cavanaugh added. “I see progress in AUKUS every day.”
Diana Stancy contributed to this report.

title: Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress?
zh_title: Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋为何辞职，Colette Kress 是谁？
source: 菲律宾在中国紧张局势中加强其最北端的防御

Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋为何辞职，Colette Kress 是谁？ |商业和经济新闻|半岛电视台
分享 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋为何辞职？Colette Kress 是谁？在社交媒体上
视频时长 15 分 43 秒 play-arrow15:43
由于事件引发安全担忧，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职
更新：26 分钟前更新：26 分钟前
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因被指控有婚外情而辞职。
英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 已接任临时首席执行官，同时该公司正在寻找永久替代者。
名单1 2Nvidia CEO黄仁勋卸任，更多事务细节曝光
list 2 of 2特朗普因英伟达丑闻而前往中国：他会对北京采取更强硬的态度吗？
该公司控制着先进人工智能 (AI) 芯片估计 90% 的市场，是世界上最有价值的公司之一。
经过几天对其个人关系和潜在国家安全问题的严格审查后，黄于周四辞职。
周日，黄承认对妻子不忠，并向家人和英伟达员工道歉。
黄小时候从台湾移居美国。在 1993 年与他人共同创立 Nvidia 之前，他的妻子 Lori 就一直陪伴在他身边。
英伟达董事会最初支持黄仁勋，周日表示对他的领导能力充满信心。它还对有关他成为中国情报部门目标的报道展开了独立调查。
但周三，路透社报道称，在进一步指控他与直接向他汇报的英伟达高级高管金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有关系后，董事会正在开会考虑是否将他免职。
该公司周四宣布辞职。黄仁勋还辞去董事会职务，结束了他 33 年的首席执行官任期。
英伟达没有给出他离职的原因。
董事会在一份声明中表示，“詹森对英伟达的贡献是深远的”，并感谢他“对公司和行业做出的不可估量的贡献”。
黄仁勋受到哪些指控？
这些指控与报道的婚外情有关。
第一起案件涉及新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang，据称她曾为中国情报部门工作。
这些指控引发了对国家安全的质疑，特别是考虑到黄仁勋支持允许英伟达向中国出售先进的人工智能芯片。
另外，《纽约时报》周三报道称，黄与直接向他汇报的英伟达医疗保健副总裁鲍威尔有染。
第二个报道的关系引发了对涉及高级管理人员的潜在利益冲突的担忧。
为什么会出现国家安全问题？
此次争议发生之际，华盛顿正就向中国出口先进的美国人工智能芯片展开辩论。
63 岁的黄仁勋多年来一直致力于反对限制 Nvidia 芯片向中国销售。
2025 年 12 月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普批准向中国出口 Nvidia 的 H200 芯片，尽管人们担心该技术可能会增强北京的人工智能能力。
这些芯片的性能大约是中国买家之前购买的 H20 型号的六倍。
出口产品须接受美国检查、运输限制、军事用途限制以及 25% 的关税。
据半岛电视台奥萨马·本·贾维德报道，据报道中国公司订购了更多

【原文 English Original】
Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress? | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera
Share Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress? on social media
Video Duration 15 minutes 43 seconds play-arrow15:43
Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO as affairs raise security concerns
Updated: 26 minutes agoUpdated: 26 minutes ago
Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned following allegations that he had extramarital affairs.
Nvidia’s chief financial officer, Colette Kress, has taken over as interim CEO while the company looks for a permanent replacement.
list 1 of 2Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down, more affair details revealed
list 2 of 2Trump heads to China amid Nvidia scandal: Will he get tougher on Beijing?
The company controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips and is one of the world’s most valuable companies.
Huang stepped down on Thursday following several days of intense scrutiny over his personal relationships and potential national security issues.
On Sunday, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and apologised to his family and to Nvidia employees.
Huang moved to the United States from Taiwan as a child. His wife, Lori, has been with him since before he co-founded Nvidia in 1993.
Nvidia’s board initially backed Huang, saying on Sunday that it had confidence in his leadership. It also launched an independent investigation into reports that he had been targeted by Chinese intelligence.
But on Wednesday, the Reuters news agency reported that the board was meeting to consider whether to remove him after further allegations of a relationship with Kimberly Powell, a senior Nvidia executive who reported directly to him.
The company announced his resignation on Thursday. Huang also resigned from the board, ending his 33-year tenure as chief executive.
Nvidia did not give a reason for his departure.
“Jensen’s contributions to Nvidia are profound,” the board said in a statement, thanking him for his “immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry”.
What are the allegations involving Jensen Huang?
The allegations were related to reported extramarital affairs.
The first involved Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based tech company Megaspeed, who is alleged to have worked for Chinese intelligence.
The allegations have raised questions about national security, particularly given Huang’s support for allowing Nvidia to sell advanced AI chips to China.
Separately, The New York Times reported on Wednesday that Huang had an affair with Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, who reported directly to him.
The second reported relationship raised concerns about a potential conflict of interest involving a senior executive.
Why are there national security concerns?
The controversy comes amid a debate in Washington over exporting advanced US AI chips to China.
Huang, 63, spent years campaigning against the restrictions on Nvidia chip sales to China.
In December 2025, US President Donald Trump approved the export of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China, despite concerns that the technology could bolster Beijing’s AI capabilities.
The chips are about six times more powerful than the H20 models previously available to Chinese buyers.
Exports are subject to US inspections, limits on shipments, restrictions on military use and a 25 percent tariff.
According to Al Jazeera’s Osama Bin Javaid, Chinese companies reportedly ordered more than two million H200 chips, potentially worth $54bn.
“Worth remembering it’s orders, not completed sales,” he said.
Critics are concerned the technology could help China close the AI gap with the US.
The allegations raised questions about whether his personal relationships could have exposed sensitive information.
“There is no established evidence he knowingly assisted Beijing or that company secrets were compromised,” Bin Javaid noted.
Nvidia’s board has also said it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.
Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
Kress has served as Nvidia’s chief financial officer since September 2013 and oversaw the chipmaker’s finances during a period of growth.
During her time at Nvidia, the company’s annual revenue rose from $4.13bn in fiscal 2014 to $215.9bn in fiscal 2026.
Before joining Nvidia, Kress held senior finance roles at Texas Instruments, Microsoft and Cisco.
She holds a bachelor’s degree in finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.
Kress is also among the wealthiest self-made women in the US, according to Forbes.
In a statement following her appointment, Kress said she was committed to building on the foundation Huang had created over the past 33 years.
Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, who has been named interim CEO following the resignation of Jensen Huang [Handout/Nvidia via AFP]
Will Colette Kress become Nvidia’s permanent CEO?
Nvidia’s board has appointed Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement and considers both internal and external candidates.
Trump has suggested former Apple chief executive Tim Cook as Huang’s successor.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump praised Huang’s work at Nvidia and said Cook was the person to replace him.
“A Legend replaces a Legend,” Trump wrote.
Cook stepped down as Apple’s chief executive in September and now serves as the company’s executive chairman.
Speaking to Al Jazeera, technology and cybersecurity analyst Ritesh Kotak said choosing Nvidia’s next CEO would be a decision for the company’s board.
“At the end of the day, it comes down to the board,” he said.
Kotak pointed to the differences between Apple, which primarily sells consumer technology, and Nvidia, whose chips power much of the AI industry.
There has been no indication that Cook is interested in the position.
Trump has defended Huang amid the allegations.
Reporting from the White House, Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher said Trump had offered a “very forceful defence” of the Nvidia cofounder, who accompanied him on a trip to China earlier this year.
Trump said he recently learned of the suspected spying scandal, although reports suggest he had been informed of the allegations before the trip.
Fisher said the president was likely to face further questions about “what he knew and when he knew it”.
Meanwhile, Huang’s departure has raised concerns about Nvidia’s future.
“He’s the captain that was steering the ship back since the early ’90s,” Kotak told Al Jazeera.
“These are big shoes that need to be filled,” he added.
Kotak said the resignation could create uncertainty among Nvidia’s employees and customers.
“If you’re Nvidia, if you’re the employees, if you’re a customer, I think you’re worried right now,” he said.
Clement Delangue, chief executive of Hugging Face, which Nvidia has agreed to acquire, reaffirmed his commitment to open-source AI following Huang’s resignation.
Meanwhile, Lloyd Blankfein, former chief executive of Goldman Sachs, reflected on Huang’s departure in a post on X.
“Sad about Jensen. Shakespearean,” he wrote, quoting former French President Charles de Gaulle: “The graveyards are filled with indispensable men.”
Huang’s departure has also raised questions about the wider AI industry. Nvidia is not only a major chip supplier but also an investor in companies that build and rent out AI computing infrastructure.
The company is also preparing to invest approximately $10bn in AI developer Anthropic as part of its planned stock market listing, expected next week.
Nvidia is in a difficult moment as it looks for a permanent CEO and faces increasing political scrutiny in Washington.
The hunt is now on for a permanent successor, and the board is open to both insider and outsider candidates, Nvidia said.
According to Reuters, several names are being discussed by industry watchers, including:
Kress, Nvidia CFO, analysts and investors have cited her experience, authority and deep relationships with Wall Street as assets that could help steer the company through the transition.
Nvidia executive Ian Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing. He joined in 2004 and helped develop technology that transformed the company from a video game chipmaker into a leading force in AI hardware.
Rene Haas, Arm CEO, spent seven formative years at Nvidia, rising to vice president and general manager.
Harvey Jones, Nvidia’s first-ever board chair, was appointed to the position following Huang’s resignation. Jones has served on Nvidia’s board since 1993, before the chipmaker went public. He also sits on the company’s audit and nominating and corporate governance committees.
Lisa Su leads AMD, one of Nvidia’s main competitors. If appointed, the announcement could represent a major disruption for AMD.
Sanjay Mehrotra, Micron CEO, has more than four decades of experience in the semiconductor industry and has worked closely with Nvidia, which uses Micron products.
And Cook, who took over at Apple shortly before cofounder Steve Jobs died in 2011, appeared as a potential candidate following Trump’s comments.
The leadership shake-up has also had an effect on the markets. Nvidia shares were down more than 14 percent at one point on Thursday before recovering some of that ground.
The major US stock indexes also closed lower.
“Investors seem to be moving past the scandal and putting their money elsewhere, shifting to other tech stocks,” Al Jazeera’s Kristen Saloomey reported from New York.
Meanwhile, US lawmakers are looking into the potential national security implications of Huang’s reported relationships.

content:
2026年3月4日，中共全國政協副主席胡春華出席在北京大會堂舉行的第十四屆全國政協第四次會議開幕式。(Lintao Zhang/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月13日訊】57歲廣東省惠州市委書記劉吉2026年10月31日被官宣免職，仕途去向不明。劉吉被免職前後，其前副手余金富落馬，多名下屬被查，52歲惠州市紀委書記黃偉東貶任閒職。
值得關注的是，劉吉是團派大員胡春華的前大祕，兩人還是湖北老鄉。劉吉與落馬的政治局委員馬興瑞曾在廣東官場有8年交集。劉吉被免職及惠州官場被清洗，背後的中共高層內鬥因素，引人猜測。
據《惠州日報》報導，2026年11月4日，廣東省惠州市人大常委會召開會議，接受劉吉辭去惠州市人大常委會主任職務的請求，接受陳宇航辭去惠州市長職務的請求；11月6日，惠州市常務副市長王濱升任市長。
2026年10月31日，據廣東省官方通報，廣東省委決定惠州市長陳宇航任惠州市委書記；57歲劉吉不再擔任惠州市委書記、常委、委員職務，「另有任用」。
據公開簡歷，劉吉，1969年5月出生，湖北黃岡市麻城人，先後獲得武漢水利電力學院水力發電工程系水電工程建築專業學士學位，新加坡南洋理工大學管理經濟學專業碩士學位；自1993年12月開始，長期在廣東省計委、發改委任職。
汪洋2007年12月至2012年12月任廣東省委書記期間，劉吉2009年2月由廣東省發改委稽察辦主任升任投資處處長，2009年9月升任廣東省發改委總經濟師、黨組成員。
胡春華2012年12月至2017年10月任廣東省委書記，期間兼任廣東省委所謂全面深化改革領導小組組長。胡春華是湖北宜昌市五峰縣人，與劉吉是湖北老鄉。
胡春華主政廣東期間，劉吉2013年9月升任廣東省發改委副主任、黨組成員；2014年3月兼任省委改革辦專職副主任；2015年1月調任廣東省委辦公廳副主任，2015年4月兼任直接服務省委書記的綜合一處處長；2016年3月升任廣東省委副祕書長，兼任改革辦主任，3個月後改為兼任省委政研室主任。劉吉先後擔任胡春華下屬、大祕、智囊近5年。
中共十九大後，李希任廣東省委書記，馬興瑞任廣東省長期間，劉吉2018年4月被調離廣東省委機關，出任惠州市委副書記，市政府黨組書記，兩個月後正式出任惠州市長；2021年10月升任惠州市委書記。
馬興瑞2013年11月由工信部副部長空降廣東任省委副書記，先後兼任政法委書記、深圳市委書記，成為時任省委書記胡春華副手，2016年12月升任廣東省長，先後與胡春華、李希搭檔，直到2021年12月調任新疆黨委書記。
劉吉在廣東省委機關及惠州市任職期間，擔任時任廣東省委副書記、省長馬興瑞的下屬8年。
馬興瑞在中共二十大晉升政治局委員，2025年7月被免去新疆黨委書記職務，2026年4月3日被官宣落馬；7月14日，被開除中共黨籍與公職；11月5日，被批捕，提起刑訴。
馬興瑞落馬前後，其曾主政的廣東、新疆官場被持續清洗，舊部接連落馬，其中包括廣東省人大常委會黨組成員、副主任張碩輔，廣東省人大常委會黨組成員覃偉中，廣東省政協黨組成員、副主席郭永航，廣東省深圳市政協原黨組書記、主席戴北方4名省部級高官。
劉吉被免職十天後，2026年11月10日，其前副手余金富在廣東陽江市長任上被官宣落馬。
據公開簡歷，余金富1972年5月出生，曾長期在廣東省對外經濟貿易委員會、商務廳任職，曾任商務廳投資促進與對外經濟合作處處長，商務廳黨組成員、公平貿易局局長。
余金富2016年10月調任惠州市副市長；2020年5月升任惠州市委常委、市委祕書長，2021年8月升任惠州市委副書記；兩個月後，2021年10月調任陽江市委副書記、市長。
期間，劉吉2018年4月至2021年10月任惠州市委副書記、市長。余金富擔任劉吉副手、下屬兩年半。
劉吉被免職前二十天，2026年10月11日，《南方都市報》報導，惠州市政府官網「領導之窗」欄目更新顯示，張建國已任惠州市委常委、紀委書記。惠州市原紀委書記黃偉東已任中山市人大常委會黨組成員。
2026年10月15日，惠州市人大常委會會議接受黃偉東辭去惠州市監察委員會主任職務的請求。2026年11月7日，中山市人大會議補選黃偉東為中山市人大常委會副主任。
據公開簡歷，張建國，1971年1月出生，長期在廣東省紀委系統任職，歷任汕尾市紀委副書記，省紀委監委駐廣東省教育廳紀檢監察組副組長，汕頭市委常委、市紀委書記。
黃偉東，1974年6月出生，曾任中山市紀委常委、中山市委辦公室主任，中山市紀委副書記、市監察局局長，揭陽市委常委、紀委書記；2024年1月調任惠州市委常委、紀委書記，與劉吉共事兩年9個月。
值得關注的是，黃偉東現年52歲，比接任惠州市紀委書記的張建國還年輕3歲，卻貶任中山市人大閒職。
劉吉2018年4月至2026年10月先後任惠州市委副書記、市長，市委書記，主政惠州市近8年半。
據官方通報，劉吉被免職前，惠州市還有多名官員被查，包括：惠州市住房和城鄉建設局黨組成員、副局長商紅新（2026年9月15日）、惠州仲愷高新區黨工委委員、管委會副主任莊煜平（2026年9月4日），惠州城市職業學院黨委書記鍾文宇（2026年7月29日），惠州市衛生健康局黨組書記、局長徐蓉（2026年4月3日），惠州市人大常委會黨組成員、副主任，原教育局黨組書記、局長袁清山（2026年1月6日）。這些落馬官員幾乎都是劉吉主政惠州時期提拔、重用的下屬。
另據惠州市紀委監委2026年7月29日通報，2026年上半年，惠州市紀檢監察機關立案1029件，其中立案縣處級幹部86人、鄉科級幹部198人。處分511人，其中處分縣處級幹部70人，鄉科級幹部132人。
除了最新落馬的原惠州市副市長、市委副書記余金富，近3年來，惠州市還有多名市級官員被查，包括原惠州市委書記陳奕威（2024年7月），原惠州市長麥教猛（2022年4月），原惠州市委副書記、政法委書記、人大常委會副主任李敏（2024年5月），惠州市人大常委會副主任、原惠州市副市長陳高燕（2024年1月）。劉吉與落馬的陳奕威、李敏、陳高燕在惠州市官場曾有交集。
團派大員胡春華曾是中共政治局常委乃至習接班人的熱門人選。胡春華在中共十九大後進京擔任副總理，仕途看漲之際，2018年至2021年，其前大祕劉吉在3年內接連升任惠州市長、市委書記。
但中共二十大上，團派遭「團滅」；胡春華被踢出政治局，轉任全國政協副主席。胡春華曾主政的內蒙古、西藏、廣東官場被清洗，不少落馬官員都是胡的舊部。而劉吉仕途在過去5年也未再獲升遷。
2024年7月中旬的三中全會起，中共黨魁習近平深陷健康與權力危機疑雲，各種傳聞不斷；乃至有傳言稱，習近平將下台，胡春華入局、入常甚至晉升軍委副主席、接班等。但有關胡春華的傳聞均落空。
胡春華2026年10月22日異常缺席中共所謂「長征」紀念大會。原內蒙古官員杜文當時爆料，胡春華及其家人已經失聯。但胡春華隨後現身2026年10月26日至29日召開的五中全會。
2026年10月24日，接近高層的中共內部人士向大紀元披露，胡春華是因身體原因沒出席會議。胡春華從政治局委員位置退出到政協，在政治上已經沒戲了。但該消息人士同時表示，中共高層權鬥「不進即退」，胡春華作為「廢太子」，也不是完全沒有落馬風險。
五中全會前後，胡春華成為海外輿論焦點之際，前大祕劉吉被免去惠州市委書記職務；劉吉曾長期主政的惠州官場震盪。
57歲正廳級高官劉吉被免職後，仕途去向不明。與此同時，劉吉前副手余金富落馬，多名下屬被查或被貶職，為其仕途命運增添高危信號。
中共政治局委員馬興瑞落馬前後，其曾任職的廣東官場被持續清洗，舊部接連落馬。劉吉與馬興瑞曾有8年交集，是否會受馬興瑞案牽連，有待觀察。
更為敏感的是，劉吉是胡春華老鄉，曾獲胡提拔、擔任胡的大祕、智囊。劉吉仕途下一站，是轉任乃至高升其它實權職位？貶任人大、政協閒職？還是落馬？將是觀察中共高層內鬥動向及胡春華仕途命運的風向標之一。+

title: 黃仁勳案女主黃樂持股實體為華為提供算力

content:
圖為2025年5月22日在台北一家餐廳，黃樂（右）出席英偉達首席執行官黃仁勳（左，身穿黑色背對攝像頭）舉辦的晚宴。(various sources/AFP)
【大紀元2026年11月13日訊】（大紀元記者夏雨綜合報導）週四（11月12日），英偉達（Nvidia）聯合創辦人黃仁勳辭去首席執行官職務。此前他被曝和一名疑似中共間諜的女子黃樂（Alice Huang）有染。最新消息揭示，黃樂和英偉達在中國最大的競爭對手華為公司有關聯。
黃樂被美國情報部門認為是中共國安部的一名間諜，她在與英偉達開展業務往來，與黃仁勳可能存在曖昧關係的同時，可能還持有某些中企的股份，而這些企業使華為從中受益。
黃樂與華為之間的關聯，最初是由私營情報公司Tesari的分析師發現。該公司將調查結果獨家提供給了CNBC。Tesari主要為私營企業和美國政府提供情報研究服務。
這一關聯此前未被披露，由Tesari首次揭露。該公司利用人工智能收集證據，並專門從事全球範圍內的國家安全調查。這些關聯可能會引發人們對黃樂在與黃仁勳交往的意圖和行為產生質疑，同時也讓人懷疑黃仁勳是否知曉黃樂與華為之間存在密切聯繫。
CNBC報導，圍繞黃樂的這些爆料，涉及一系列錯綜複雜的企業和交易，表明她與中國某些實體存在聯繫，而這些實體最終為華為在中國提供算力。
華為是中共扶持的關鍵企業，也是實現中共全球技術主導地位野心的關鍵一環，與中共關係密切，多年前美國商務部就將華為納入出口管制黑名單，並在全國乃至世界範圍內剔除華為設備。
據CNBC審閱的文件顯示，與黃樂有關聯的實體曾參與向華為提供英偉達的算力資源。這一情況發生的時間，與她和黃仁勳於2023年12月首次公開同框出現的時間大致吻合。
2024年，英偉達將華為列為主要競爭對手，特別是在人工智能芯片領域，包括圖形處理器（GPU）、中央處理器（CPU）以及網絡芯片。
CNBC報導，「通過對黃樂人脈網絡的分析，我們發現了這些活動。這有必要引發一項涉及國家安全及（技術）防擴散的調查。」Tesari公司負責國家安全應用的副總裁布萊恩‧安德森（Brian Andersen）表示。他曾在美國國土安全調查局（Homeland Security Investigations）擔任主管級特別探員。
安德森指出，如果美國商務部工業與安全局（Bureau of Industry and Security）及國土安全調查局發現證據，表明「有人未經授權向華為轉移了受管制設備」，那麼相關方可能面臨的指控包括違反出口管制規定、共謀以及走私等。
黃樂與華為之間的關聯錯綜複雜，以至於Tesari的分析師向CNBC表示，根據他們以往的調查經驗，這種關聯很可能是經過精心設計的，旨在刻意掩蓋雙方的關係。
2015年起，黃樂投身私募股權投資，先後擔任上海和熙投資執行董事兼合夥人、上海韻禧投資董事。其後，黃樂建立上海、浙江商業網絡；相關網絡參與騰訊數據中心建設，並投資中國電科旗下網絡安全企業。
2021年，上海和熙收購了數據中心開發商「上海世紀龍騰」（Shanghai Century Longteng）27%的股份，並持有該股份直至2024年。該公司在中國內地持有一家名為深圳Yifeng（Shenzhen Yifeng Technology Co., Ltd.）的數據中心企業50.1%的控股權。而其背後的大股東為中國上市企業世紀華通（Zhejiang Century Huatong Group）。
深圳Yifeng是華為雲（Huawei Cloud）的算力與數據中心服務供應商。
由此可見，深圳Yifeng處於一條橫跨「中國本土算力基建」與「海外AI芯片供應鏈」的複雜資本網絡中。它與世紀華通具有直接的股權控股關係，並透過關鍵人物黃樂及同一資本體系，與新加坡芯片買家Megaspeed形成平行關聯。
據CNBC披露，雖然目前尚無直接證據顯示深圳Yifeng數據中心內部是否直接部署了受管制的Nvidia GPU，但其控股母公司世紀華通自2023年起便開始大量採購英偉達芯片，同時深圳Yifeng亦向華為雲（Huawei Cloud）提供算力租賃服務。
此外，2022年，黃樂的丈夫、和熙創辦人康偉成為「世紀龍騰」的高管；該公司持有深圳數據中心的控股權，康偉也出席了該公司與華為協議的簽署儀式。
2023年3月，黃樂旗下「Huang Le Limited」收購第七大道新加坡分支，將其更名為「超速國際」（Megaspeed International），並出任董事總經理。同年12月，黃樂與黃仁勳及多名英偉達同事在新加坡意大利餐廳會面。四天後，超速國際成為英偉達雲端合作夥伴。
根據彭博社2025年的報導，Megaspeed過去三年一直是英偉達最大的海外客戶之一，購買了近50億美元的人工智能（AI）芯片和先進硬件。這些芯片受美國出口管制。
週三（11日），Axios等媒體報導說，知情人士透露，美國財政部長斯科特‧貝森特（Scott Bessent）就Megaspeed未被列入黑名單一事，質問了商務部長霍華德‧盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）。+

The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG) from Taiwan is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is April 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
Applicable November 10, 2026.
Javeria Ali or Jacob Waddell, AD/CVD Operations, Office VI, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0462 or (202) 482-1369, respectively.
This preliminary determination is made in accordance with section 733(b) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act). Commerce published the notice of initiation of this investigation on May 5, 2026.[1] On August 28, 2026, Commerce postponed the preliminary determination of this investigation and the revised deadline is now November 4, 2026.[2]
For a complete description of the events that followed the initiation of this investigation, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.[3] A list of topics ( printed page 72518) included in the Preliminary Decision Memorandum is included as Appendix II to this notice. The Preliminary Decision Memorandum is a public document and is on file electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), which is available to registered users at https://access.trade.gov. In addition, a complete version of the Preliminary Decision Memorandum can be accessed directly at https://access.trade.gov/​frnotices.
The product covered by this investigation is PTMEG from Taiwan. For a complete description of the scope of this investigation, see Appendix I.
In accordance with the Preamble to Commerce's regulations,[4] the Initiation Notice set aside a period of time for parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[5] Certain interested parties commented on the scope of the investigation as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. For a summary of the product coverage comments and rebuttal comments submitted to the record for this preliminary determination, and accompanying discussion and analysis of all comments timely received, see the Preliminary Scope Decision Memorandum.[6] Commerce is preliminarily not modifying the scope language as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. See the scope in Appendix I to this notice.
Commerce is conducting this investigation in accordance with section 731 of the Act. Commerce has calculated export prices in accordance with section 772(a) of the Act. Normal value is calculated in accordance with section 773 of the Act. Pursuant to section 776(a) and (b) of the Act, Commerce has preliminarily relied upon facts otherwise available, with adverse inferences, for Formosa Asahi Spandex Co., Ltd (FAS). For a full description of the methodology underlying the preliminary determination, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.
Sections 733(d)(1)(ii) and 735(c)(5)(A) of the Act provide that in the preliminary determination, Commerce shall determine an estimated all-others rate for all exporters and producers not individually examined. This rate shall be an amount equal to the weighted average of the estimated weighted-average dumping margins established for exporters and producers individually investigated, excluding any zero and de minimis margins, and any margins determined entirely under section 776 of the Act.
In this investigation, Commerce preliminarily assigned a rate based entirely on adverse facts available to FAS. Therefore, the only rate that is not zero, de minimis or based entirely on facts otherwise available is the rate calculated for Dairen Chemical Corporation (Dairen). Consequently, the rate calculated for Dairen is also assigned as the rate for all other producers and exporters.
Commerce preliminarily determines that the following estimated weighted-average dumping margins exist:

In accordance with section 733(d)(2) of the Act, Commerce will direct U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to suspend liquidation of entries of subject merchandise, as described in Appendix I, entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after the date of publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Further, pursuant to section 733(d)(1)(B) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(d), Commerce will instruct CBP to require a cash deposit equal to the estimated weighted-average dumping margin or the estimated all-others rate, as follows: (1) the cash deposit rate for the respondents listed above will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margins determined in this preliminary determination; (2) if the exporter is not a respondent identified above, but the producer is, then the cash deposit rate will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margin established for that producer of the subject merchandise. These suspension of liquidation instructions will remain in effect until further notice.
Commerce intends to disclose its calculations and analysis performed to interested parties in this preliminary determination within five days of any public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b).
Consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(e), Commerce will analyze and, if appropriate, correct any timely allegations of significant ministerial errors by amending the preliminary determination. However, consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(d), Commerce will not consider incomplete allegations that do not address the significance standard under 19 CFR 351.224(g) following the preliminary determination. Instead, Commerce will address such allegations in the final determination together with issues raised in the case briefs or other written comments.
As provided in section 782(i)(1) of the Act, Commerce intends to verify the information relied upon in making its final determination.
Non-scope related case briefs or other written comments may be submitted to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance no later than seven days after the date on which the last verification report is issued in this investigation. Rebuttal briefs, limited to issues raised in the case briefs, may be filed not later than five days after the date for filing case briefs.[7] Interested parties who submit case briefs or rebuttal briefs in this proceeding must submit: (1) a table of contents listing each issue; and (2) a table of authorities.[8]
As provided under 19 CFR 351.309(c)(2)(iii) and (d)(2)(iii), we request that interested parties provide at the beginning of their briefs a public, executive summary for each issue raised ( printed page 72519) in their briefs.[9] Further, we request that interested parties limit their executive summary of each issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. We intend to use the executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the issues and decision memorandum that will accompany the final determination in this investigation. We request that interested parties include footnotes for relevant citations in the executive summary of each issue. Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[10]
Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.310(c), interested parties who wish to request a hearing, limited to issues raised in the case and rebuttal briefs, must submit a written request to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance, U.S. Department of Commerce, within 30 days after the date of publication of this notice. Requests should contain: 1) the party's name, address, and telephone number; 2) the number of participants and whether any participant is a foreign national; and 3) a list of the issues to be discussed. If a request for a hearing is made, Commerce intends to hold the hearing at a time and date to be determined. Parties should confirm by telephone the date, time, and location of the hearing two days before the scheduled date.
Postponement of Final Determination and Extension of Provisional Measures
Section 735(a)(2) of the Act provides that a final determination may be postponed until not later than 135 days after the date of the publication of the preliminary determination if, in the event of an affirmative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by exporters who account for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise, or in the event of a negative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by the petitioner. Section 351.210(e)(2) of Commerce's regulations requires that a request by exporters for postponement of the final determination be accompanied by a request for extension of provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not more than six months in duration.
On August 20, 2026, pursuant to 19 CFR 351.210(e), Dairen requested that Commerce postpone the final determination and that provisional measures be extended to a period not to exceed six months.[11] In accordance with section 735(a)(2)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.210(b)(2)(ii), because: (1) the preliminary determination is affirmative; (2) the requesting exporter accounts for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise; and (3) no compelling reasons for denial exist, Commerce is postponing the final determination and extending the provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not greater than six months. Accordingly, Commerce will make its final determination no later than 135 days after the date of publication of this preliminary determination.
U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) Notification
In accordance with section 733(f) of the Act, Commerce will notify the ITC of its preliminary determination of sales at LTFV. If the final determination is affirmative, the ITC will determine before the later of 120 days after the date of this preliminary determination or 45 days after the final determination whether these imports are materially injuring, or threaten material injury to, the U.S. industry.
This determination is issued and published in accordance with sections 733(f) and 777(i)(1) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.205(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by the investigation is polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG), which is a polymer consisting of linear diols ( i.e., organic chemical compound that has two hydroxyl (- OH) functional groups) with a molecular backbone of repeating tetramethylene units (- CH2CH2CH2CH2-) interconnected through ether bonds ( i.e., a single oxygen atom bonded to two carbon atoms), with a chemical formula HO{(CH2)4}nOH. PTMEG is also referred to as Polytetrahydrofuran, PTHF, Polytetramethylene ether glycol, PTMG, and Polybutylene glycol. PTMEG is typically blended with butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) or another stabilizer such as higher molecular weight hindered phenols or phosphoric acid. In addition to a stabilizer, PTMEG is sometimes blended with a modifier or additive, such as phosphoric acid or sulfuric acid. The scope includes all blends consisting of PTMEG and stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, where the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively account for no more than two percent of the total weight of the PTMEG blend. PTMEG is normally associated with Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number 25190-06-1.
The scope includes all forms of PTMEG, regardless of physical form, purity, molecular weight, number of hydroxyls, number of acids, color, density, softening point, glass transition point, flash point, water content, viscosity, and packaging. PTMEG that has been blended with other products is included within this scope when such blends include constituent parts that have been intermingled but that have not been chemically reacted with each other to produce a different product. For such blends, only the PTMEG component of the mixture, inclusive of any stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively accounting for no more than two percent of the combined weight of the PTMEG component and the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The scope includes merchandise matching the above description that has been processed in a third country, including by commingling, diluting, introducing, or removing stabilizers, modifiers, or additives, or performing any other processing that would not otherwise remove the merchandise from the scope of the investigation if performed in the subject country. The scope also includes PTMEG that is commingled or blended with PTMEG from sources not subject to the investigation. Only the subject component of such commingled products is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The subject merchandise is classifiable in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) under subheading 3907.29.0000. Subject merchandise may also be imported under HTSUS subheadings 2932.11.0000 and 3404.90.5150. Although the HTSUS subheading and CAS registry number are provided for convenience and customs purposes, the written description of the scope is dispositive.

title: 5th Air Force hosts JAAGA, strengthening U.S.-Japan bilateral operations at Yokota
zh_title: 第五航空队主办 JAAGA，加强在横田的美日双边行动
summary: 2026 年 11 月 9 日，日本横田空军基地 — 第 5 空军于 2026 年 11 月 5 日访问横田空军基地期间接待了日美空军亲善协会 (JAAGA) 的 36 名成员，加强了美国空军人员、日本航空自卫队成员和日本社区领导人之间的长期关系。代表团成员包括退役中将、JAAGA副总裁、日本航空自卫队防空司令部原司令官武藤茂树，以及日本国防工业的退役高级军官和代表。稻月英忠中将，现任 ADC 司令兼上校。
content:
2026 年 11 月 9 日

日本横田空军基地 — 2026 年 11 月 5 日，第五空军接待了日美空军亲善协会 (JAAGA) 的 36 名成员访问横田空军基地，加强了美国空军人员、日本航空自卫队成员和日本社区领导人之间的长期关系。

代表团成员包括退役中将、JAAGA副总裁、日本航空自卫队防空司令部原司令官武藤茂树，以及日本国防工业的退役高级军官和代表。现任防空司令部司令稻月英忠中将和第 5 空军副司令 Nathan Colunga 上校与另外 18 名日本航空自卫队和第 5 空军高级军官和士官一起参加了此次交战。

此次访问包括与第五空军和日本航空自卫队领导人讨论美日同盟、双边合作以及社区关系在支持任务中的作用。该计划还为 JAAGA 成员提供了直接与飞行员接触的机会，并更多地了解横田在支持区域行动方面的作用。

Colunga 在对 JAAGA 成员参与此次活动表示感谢后表示：“如果说我在第五空军的短时间内学到了一件事，那就是这里有着令人难以置信的合作伙伴关系。今天是我们聚在一起并进一步了解彼此的机会。”
JAAGA 成立于 1996 年，由日本航空自卫队退役成员组成，致力于促进美国和日本空军之间的友谊、相互理解和信任。该组织还表彰那些致力于加强双边合作并支持专业、文化和社区交流的美国和日本人员。

“我们非常感谢今天有机会参观 ADC 和第五空军总部，”武藤说。 “‘Koku-Jieitai’与美国空军之间的牢固联系，特别是在横田，是日美同盟的一个非常重要的组成部分，在维护该地区的和平与稳定方面发挥着至关重要的作用。” _Koku-Jieitai_ 是日本航空自卫队的日本官方名称的缩写形式。

一整天，领导人都强调联盟是一种日常运作关系，而不是偶尔的接触。他们讨论了总部之间的合作、规划和训练，以及随着美国和日本军队扩大双边活动，与当地社区保持牢固关系的重要性。

“防空司令部在横田空军基地驻扎了 40 年，”稻月说。 “我们不仅与第 5 空军，还与第 374 空运联队并肩合作。”
日本航空自卫队防空司令部领导人还提供了超出战斗机操作范围的任务背景，包括雷达监视和运输支持。

JAAGA 与第五空军和 ADC 的持续合作反映了其作为美国军方、日本航空自卫队退伍军人、行业领导者和日本社区之间桥梁的作用。这些关系对于维持联盟的相互理解和支持仍然至关重要。

“俗话说，‘强大的联盟建立在三件事之上：信任、友谊和相互支持，’”武藤说。 “JAAGA 将始终尽最大努力加强这些联系并支持日美联盟。这是我们对您的承诺，无论何时您需要我们的支持，

【原文 English Original】
09 November 2026

YOKOTA AIR BASE, Japan — 5th Air Force hosted 36 members of the Japan-America Air Force Goodwill Association, or JAAGA, during a visit to Yokota Air Base Nov. 5, 2026, reinforcing the longstanding relationship among U.S. Air Force personnel, Japan Air Self-Defense Force members and Japanese community leaders.

The delegation included retired Lt. Gen. Shigeki Muto, JAAGA vice president and former commander of JASDF Air Defense Command, as well as retired senior officers and representatives from Japan’s defense industry. Lt. Gen. Inatsuki Hidetada, current ADC commander and Col. Nathan Colunga, 5th AF deputy commander, participated in the engagement alongside a total of 18 additional JASDF and 5th AF senior commissioned and noncommissioned officers.

The visit included discussions with 5th Air Force and JASDF leaders on the U.S.-Japan alliance, bilateral cooperation and the role of community relationships in supporting the mission. The program also gave JAAGA members an opportunity to engage directly with Airmen and learn more about Yokota’s role in supporting regional operations.

After expressing his gratitude for JAAGA members’ participation in the event, Colunga said, “If I learned one thing in the short time that I’ve been here with 5th Air Force, it’s that there is an incredible partnership here. Today is an opportunity for us to come together and get to know each other a little bit closer.”

JAAGA, which was established in 1996, has significant representation from retired JASDF members and promotes friendship, mutual understanding and trust between U.S. and Japanese air forces. The organization also recognizes U.S. and Japanese personnel whose work strengthens bilateral cooperation and supports professional, cultural and community exchanges.

“We really appreciate the opportunity to visit the ADC and 5th Air Force Headquarters today,” said Muto. “The strong bond between the _Koku-Jieitai_ and the U.S. Air Force, especially here in Yokota is a very important part of the Japan-U.S. Alliance which plays a vital role in maintaining peace and stability in this region.” _Koku-Jieitai_ is the shortened form of the official Japanese name for the Japan Air Self-Defense Force.

Throughout the day leaders highlighted the alliance as a daily operational relationship rather than an occasional engagement. They discussed cooperation between headquarters, planning and training, as well as the importance of maintaining strong relationships with local communities as U.S. and Japanese forces expand bilateral activities.

“The Air Defense Command has been stationed at Yokota Air Base for 40 years,” said Inatsuki. “We have been shoulder to shoulder working together with not only the 5th Air Force but with the 374th [Airlift Wing] as well.”

JASDF Air Defense Command leaders also provided context on missions that extend beyond fighter operations, including radar surveillance, and transportation support.

JAAGA’s continued engagement with 5th AF and the ADC reflects its role as a bridge between the U.S. military, JASDF veterans, industry leaders and Japanese communities. Those relationships remain essential to sustaining mutual understanding and support for the alliance.

“As the saying goes, ‘A strong alliance is built on three things: trust, friendship and mutual support,’” said Muto. “JAAGA will always do its best to strengthen these bonds and support the Japan-U.S. Alliance. This is our promise to you, whenever you need our support, JAAGA is always glad to assist.”

title: Navy Region Hawaii Federal Fire Hosts Hiring Event
zh_title: 海军区夏威夷联邦消防队举办招聘活动
summary: 2026 年 11 月 9 日媒体发布：夏威夷珍珠港-希卡姆联合基地 — 夏威夷海军区联邦消防局 (FFD) 将举办为期两天的招聘活动，招募多达 40 名全职消防员，以增强欧胡岛军事设施的应急响应能力。活动将于上午 9 点至下午 2 点举行。 11 月 16 日至 17 日在 FFD 行政办公室（地址：650 Centre Dr., Bldg.） 284 在檀香山。仅在为期两天的活动中亲自接受申请。海军有 13 个联邦消防局站，分布在国防部的各个部门
content:
2026 年 11 月 9 日

媒体报道：夏威夷珍珠港-希卡姆联合基地 — 夏威夷海军区联邦消防局 (FFD) 正在举办为期两天的招聘活动，招募多达 40 名全职消防员，以增强欧胡岛军事设施的应急响应能力。

活动将于上午 9 点至下午 2 点举行。 11 月 16 日至 17 日在 FFD 行政办公室（地址：650 Centre Dr., Bldg.） 284 在檀香山。仅在为期两天的活动中亲自接受申请。

海军拥有 13 个联邦消防局站，分布在欧胡岛的每个国防部设施中。近 300 名平民男女提供消防和紧急服务，并通过互助响应为夏威夷州机场部门、檀香山消防局以及檀香山市县紧急医疗服务部门提供支持。

联邦消防局地区消防队长格雷格·森口表示：“我们的联邦消防员每天都在前线服务，保护整个岛屿的军人、他们的家人、文职人员以及重要的国家安全资产。” “这次招聘活动为合格、敬业的男女提供了一个绝佳的机会，让他们在为夏威夷军事界服务的同时，建立有价值的公务员职业生涯。”

**选择过程和可用性要求**
所有感兴趣的候选人必须在两天的入学窗口内亲自提交申请包。不接受数字或邮寄提交的材料。

在初步数据包筛选后，将通过电子邮件直接联系被选中进入下一个评估阶段的候选人。申请人必须验证其提交的简历是否包含准确且有效的电子邮件地址。

继续前进的候选人必须在以下筛选窗口期间保持完全可用：

* 第一筛选阶段：2026 年 11 月 23 日至 25 日
* 第二筛选阶段：2026年11月30日至12月4日

在此期间未能参加预定的评估将取消候选人进一步考虑的资格。

**最低资格和资格标准**

要考虑就业，候选人必须满足以下强制性基本要求：

* 公民身份和执照：必须是美国公民并拥有有效的州驾驶执照。
* 教育：拥有高中文凭或同等学历（GED）。
* 年龄要求：最高报名年龄为37岁。根据管理消防员公务员职位的联邦法规，候选人必须在年满 37 岁当月的最后一天或之前正式任命（雇用）。
* 医疗和身体准备：必须能够通过全面的身体能力测试、就业前体检和强制性药物筛查。
* 安全许可：必须有资格获得并维持有利的联邦安全许可。
* 所需认证：强烈希望并首选通过国家紧急医疗技术人员注册处 (NREMT) 获得当前紧急医疗技术人员 (EMT) 认证。

**申请清单和所需文件**

申请人应准备一份全面的申请材料，并将所需的文件直接带到 FFD 总部的受理站。

每个申请人包裹必须包含：

* 专业简历：严格限制不超过两页。
* 许可证和认证：所有适用的消防、医疗或技术救援证书的清晰复印件

【原文 English Original】
09 November 2026

MEDIA RELEASE: JOINT BASE PEARL HARBOR-HICKAM, Hawaii — The Navy Region Hawaii Federal Fire Department (FFD) is hosting a two-day hiring event to recruit up to 40 full-time firefighters to bolster emergency response capabilities across military installations on Oahu.

The event will be held from 9 a.m. - 2 p.m. on Nov. 16 and 17 at FFD’s administrative offices, located at 650 Center Dr., Bldg. 284 in Honolulu. Applications are only being accepted in-person at the two-day event.

The Navy has 13 Federal Fire Department stations distributed across every Department of Defense installation on Oahu. Nearly 300 civilian men and women provide fire and emergency services and support the State of Hawaii Airports Division, Honolulu Fire Department, and City and County of Honolulu Emergency Medical Services Division with mutual aid response.

“Our federal firefighters serve on the front lines every day, safeguarding service members, their families, civilian personnel, and vital national security assets throughout the islands,” said Gregg Moriguchi, Federal Fire Department regional fire chief. “This recruitment drive offers qualified, dedicated men and women an exceptional opportunity to build a rewarding civil service career while serving the military community in Hawaii.”

**Selection Process & Availability Requirements**

All interested candidates must submit their application packets in person during the two-day intake window. Digital or mailed submissions will not be accepted.

Following initial packet screening, candidates selected to advance to the next evaluation phase will be contacted directly via email. Applicants must verify that their submitted resumes contain an accurate, functioning email address.

Candidates moving forward must maintain complete availability during the following screening windows:

*   First Screening Phase: Nov. 23–25, 2026
*   Second Screening Phase: Nov. 30 – Dec. 4, 2026

Failure to attend scheduled assessments during these periods will disqualify candidates from further consideration.

**Minimum Qualifications & Eligibility Criteria**

To be considered for employment, candidates must meet the following mandatory baseline requirements:

*   Citizenship & Licensure: Must be a U.S. citizen and possess a valid state driver's license.
*   Education: Possession of a high school diploma or equivalent (GED).
*   Age Requirement: Maximum entry age is 37 years old. By federal statute governing firefighter civil service positions, candidates must be officially appointed (hired) on or before the last day of the month in which they reach age 37.
*   Medical & Physical Readiness: Must be capable of passing a comprehensive physical ability test, a pre-employment medical examination, and mandatory drug screening.
*   Security Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a favorable federal security clearance.
*   Desired Certification: Current Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) certification via the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) is strongly desired and preferred.

**Application Checklist & Required Documents**

Applicants should assemble a comprehensive application package and bring the required paperwork directly to the intake station at FFD Headquarters.

Each applicant package must contain:

*   Professional Resume: Limited strictly to no more than two pages.
*   Licenses & Certifications: Legible photocopies of all applicable fire, medical, or technical rescue credentials (e.g., NREMT, state EMT/paramedic licenses, CPR/BLS certifications).
*   Military Service Records: Copy of DD Form 214 (Member 4 or Service copy), if applicable, verifying honorable military service.
*   Veterans’ Preference Documentation: Standard Form 15 (SF-15) and accompanying VA disability rating letters or documentation, if claiming veterans’ preference.
*   Academic Transcripts: Unofficial copies of college transcripts reflecting any completed higher education coursework or degrees.

**Privacy Notice** Candidates are strictly advised NOT to include sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII), including Social Security numbers or full dates of birth, on submitted resumes or accompanying informal application forms.

“对于投资者来说，将英伟达的成功与黄仁勋分开是很困难的，而对于华盛顿来说，将英伟达与国家安全分开也几乎同样困难，”杰西说。她现在认为国会有机会对该公司对国家安全的影响进行更大的监督，并加强半导体出口管制。肯顿指出，国会对芯片限制的势头不断增强，例如《人工智能监督法案》、《芯片安全法案》和《匹配法案》。
展望未来，特丽莎敦促政府加强审查。她认为，“鉴于支持美国人工智能领先地位的公司很少，政策制定者应该认真考虑政府的直接监督”，例如对公司领导层及其主要客户的安全许可要求，以及对出口实体的安全审计作为出口许可证的先决条件。

East Asia Technology & Innovation United States and Canada

What Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit means for Washington, Wall Street, and Beijing
It’s a lot to process. On Thursday, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. But the implications extend beyond the man and his former company, a critical engine of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom because of its leading-edge computer processors. Below, Atlantic Council experts work through how the personnel shakeup could impact US policy, global markets, and more.
TODAY’S EXPERT REACTION BROUGHT TO YOU BY
Trisha Ray: Associate director and resident fellow at the GeoTech Center
Graham Brookie (@GrahamBrookie): Vice president for technology programs and strategy
Jessie Yin: Associate director with the GeoEconomics Center
Kenton Thibaut (@kentonthibaut): Senior resident China fellow at the Digital Forensic Research Lab
Nvidia’s advanced chips are “the linchpin of the United States’ leverage in slowing down the AI capabilities of its adversaries,” Trisha explains. But that advantage is also “a single point of failure,” since US export controls are only as strong as the security practices of a handful of companies and people within them.
Graham sees the incident not as a failure in US intelligence, “but rather a broader failure of coordination and policy execution in how the US government manages national security threats.” With the AI industry vulnerable to intellectual property theft and direct targeting, Washington was “caught flat footed” in risk management and export policy enforcement.
“As difficult as it is for investors to separate Nvidia’s success from Jensen Huang, it has become nearly as difficult for Washington to separate Nvidia from national security,” Jessie argues. She now sees an opening for Congress to exert greater oversight of the company’s impact on national security and tighten semiconductor export controls. Kenton points to growing momentum in Congress behind chip restrictions such as the AI Overwatch Act, the Chip Security Act, and the MATCH Act.
Going forward, Trisha urges greater government scrutiny. “Given how few companies underpin the US AI lead, policymakers should seriously consider direct government oversight,” she argues, such as security clearance–like requirements for company leadership and their major customers, as well as security audits of the exporting entities as a precondition for export licenses.
Markets were down slightly today, as Nvidia shares took a hit. Huang’s departure has investors wondering if Nvidia can sustain its dominance without the leader who became a synonym to its success. The company is “going to be unsteady for a while,” Jessie surmises.
The stakes are higher than Nvidia’s stock price alone. The US economy is already highly exposed to the fortunes of a handful of AI companies that “also happen to be the country’s primary strategic assets in a determinative domain of geopolitical competition,” Graham warns. A failure at one could reverberate across the US economy and national security ecosystem.
Beyond selling chips, Nvidia has become a major financier of the AI boom—known as “the central bank of AI”—investing in startups and supporting customers that buy its products. Jessie says that the coming months will show “how integral Nvidia has become to AI demand itself.”
Sign up to receive rapid insight in your inbox from Atlantic Council experts on global events as they unfold.
Ahead of a planned meeting next week between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Beijing warned Washington earlier today against further technology restrictions, Kenton notes.
Huang had long opposed strict export controls and was able to speak with both Trump and Xi. “But with Huang out of the picture, there is potentially more political leeway to push forward on a more hawkish approach,” Kenton says.
Jessie adds that the scandal has “permanently damaged the company’s credibility to push back on export controls,” relationships aside.
But tougher controls could invite retaliation, Kenton warns. “Beijing could answer new restrictions with curbs on critical minerals or probes of other American firms,” potentially complicating the upcoming Trump-Xi meeting.

莫斯科长期以来一直利用塞尔维亚作为破坏科索沃稳定的杠杆。2017年，一列俄罗斯制造的火车开往科索沃北部，这是一次带有“科索沃是塞尔维亚”口号的滚动挑衅。俄罗斯在科索沃附近运营着一个所谓的人道主义中心，该中心被怀疑充当俄罗斯情报站。塞尔维亚与俄罗斯密切的情报联系使莫斯科能够接触到准备挑衅的当地民族主义力量。 2023年，科索沃北部警察遭到武装袭击，普里什蒂纳将此归咎于塞尔维亚支持的武装分子，这加剧了人们对与俄罗斯结盟的行为体利用紧张局势的担忧；今年早些时候，俄罗斯外交部长警告称，“欧洲中心正在酝酿一场重大爆炸性局势”。紧张局势一再爆发。 2023年5月，塞尔维亚抗议者与科索沃警察发生冲突，造成90多名北约维和人员受伤，促使塞尔维亚提高军事戒备级别。那年 9 月，在巴尼斯卡发生的一次袭击中，全副武装的塞族枪手杀死了一名科索沃警察，并将自己关在一座修道院里，这表明当地的冲突可以多么迅速地演变为地区危机。危险还没有过去。塞尔维亚强人亚历山大·武契奇承认在10月25日的塞尔维亚议会选举中落败，但贝尔格莱德的外交政策方向尚不确定，人们担心其对科索沃的看法不会改变。

【原文 English Original】
As the Pentagon finalizes its review of U.S. force posture in Europe, one relatively small commitment deserves protection from the budget axe: the roughly 600 American troops serving in NATO’s Kosovo Force. They barely register in a debate about brigades and billion-dollar line items, but they keep a hard-won peace in the Balkans, and pulling them out would save almost nothing while handing Moscow a cheap strategic win. KFOR was deployed in June 1999 under NATO command, after the alliance bombed Yugoslavia to stop the violence perpetrated by Slobodan Milosevic’s Serbian forces against ethnic Albanians. Kosovo declared independence in 2008, but Serbia, backed by Russia and China, still refuses to recognize it. The Europe posture review is a legitimate exercise. After years of urging European allies to shoulder more of their own conventional defense, the Trump administration is right to ask hard questions about where American forces add unique value and where Europe can step up given suitable time to develop their capabilities and capacities. But KFOR is a mission in which the American role is not easily replaced, because it is as much political as military, and where a wrong call risks instability on Europe’s southeastern flank. Start with the threat. Even while absorbing heavy losses in Ukraine, Vladimir Putin has not given up on destabilizing Europe. The Balkans, Europe’s soft underbelly, are a favored arena: cheap to stir, a place to distract Western attention from Ukraine. Moscow has long used Serbia as a lever against Kosovo’s stability. In 2017, a Russian-made train was sent toward northern Kosovo, a rolling provocation that bore the slogan “Kosovo is Serbia.” Russia runs a so-called humanitarian center near Kosovo that is suspected of serving as a Russian intelligence station. Close Serbian-Russian intelligence ties give Moscow access to local nationalist forces prepared for provocations. In 2023, an armed attack on Kosovo police in the north, which Pristina blamed on Serbian-backed militants, heightened fears that Russian-aligned actors were exploiting the tension; earlier that year, Russia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs warned that “a major explosive situation is brewing in the heart of Europe.” Tensions have repeatedly flared. In May 2023, clashes between Serb protesters and Kosovo police injured more than 90 NATO peacekeepers and prompted Serbia to raise its military alert level. That September, an attack in Banjska, where heavily armed Serb gunmen killed a Kosovo police officer and barricaded themselves in a monastery, showed how quickly a local flare-up can become a regional crisis. The danger has not passed. Serbian strongman Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in Serbia’s Oct. 25 parliamentary election, but Belgrade’s foreign-policy direction is uncertain and there are concerns that its views on Kosovo will not change. In October, Russia’s ambassador to the UN warned that the situation in Kosovo “remains persistently tense and is literally teetering on the brink.” Still, Kosovo and Serbia have remained at peace since 1999, in large part because of KFOR. In the words of a bipartisan group of U.S lawmakers, the force functions as “a political deterrent to those seeking to stoke ethnic violence.” An American drawdown from KFOR may embolden nationalist agendas in Kosovo and Serbia as well as separatist ambitions in Republika Srpska, the Serb-dominated region in nearby Bosnia. The American presence in KFOR is valued precisely because it is American. U.S. troops have anchored KFOR since its creation, and Washington currently leads Regional Command East, a position of real operational weight, not symbolism. The U.S. has traditionally provided the 600 or so American troops—often Army National Guardsmen—an economy-of-force mission with minimal cost or effect on the U.S. Army’s ability to execute missions elsewhere around the globe. The mission accounts for less than 1 percent of the total U.S. troops in Europe. KFOR’s value becomes plain when contrasted with Operation Althea in neighboring Bosnia. EUFOR, an EU-led force with roughly 1,500 troops, has struggled to respond decisively to repeated provocations by Republika Srpska leader Milorad Dodik, who’s backed by Moscow and Belgrade. EU ambassadors rejected Bosnian appeals to help enforce an arrest warrant against him in 2025, citing political risk. Dodik has openly mocked EUFOR’s patrols. Lacking an American anchor and a unified chain of command willing to act, EUFOR has too often had to manage crises rather than deterring them. KFOR, by contrast, has demonstrated it can surge forces when tested, providing genuine deterrence. After the 2023 Banjska incident, NATO increased its peacekeeping presence in Kosovo. Serbia drew down its border deployment, ending the crisis. The Pentagon is right to ask what the value of an American military presence is worth. For KFOR, the answer is plain: a few hundred U.S. troops are successfully maintaining a quarter-century-long peace that Russia would love to see unravel. Lawmakers from both parties already understand that. The Pentagon should, too, and keep KFOR intact. Mark Montgomery, a retired U.S. Navy rear admiral, serves as a senior director at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies’ (FDD), where Ivana Stradner is a research fellow. ]]>

【原文 English Original】
A California robotics company called Machina has been issued a $9 million award for a containerized system to robotically mass-produce Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) airframes close to the point of need. As TWZ has frequently noted , LUCAS drones, and one-way attack weapons like them, are playing an increasing role in U.S. combat operations and military planning. The award to Machina is the latest example of the Pentagon’s push to use containerized 3D printing and other advanced fabricating systems closer to the front lines to shorten supply chains that could get severely degraded in a major conflict. Decentralizing production of drones also allows units to be more flexible and tailor their own production to their specific needs at any given moment. For instance, a unit can produce variations of multiple designs that are best suited to an upcoming mission instead of having to use whatever they are shipped. (Machina) This 18-month contract from the Defense Department’s Organic Industrial Base Modernization Challenge calls for Machina to prove it can build LUCAS drones at deployed locations with its RoboCraftsman system, Ed Mehr, founder and CEO of Machina, told TWZ Friday afternoon. A decision on producing them at scale in many other locales will come later. A LUCAS drone six-foot half-scale test model created by Machina’s RoboCraftsman system during a flight test at Edwards Air Force Base. (Machina) Creating containerized production of drones and components using 3D printing and other advanced manufacturing techniques at the forward edge is a burgeoning industry. The Machina system is one of a rapidly growing number of capabilities built around this concept, although many focus on smaller drones. Building Drones Near The Point Of Need Initially, the plan calls for Machina to set up so-called “Edge Factories” at two locations in the continental United States, said Mehr. However, the ultimate goal is to be able to deploy them to forward locations in countries like Kuwait. The Edge Factories consist of the company’s containerized RoboCraftsman manufacturing cells, Mehr told us. A 20-foot by 36-foot system that weighs 120,000 pounds fully installed, it is essentially two robotic arms that form the airframe out of metal using reductive manufacturing based on a variety of requirements. Payload weight, range and other factors are punched into a software system designed by the nTop company and the robotic arms then cut the metal into the desired form factor based on the required specifications. Machina uses metal instead of composites that many drones are made out of because “not only it is cheaper, it is more widely available and now can be processed with an automated process like ours versus composites, which are all done by hand layup ,” Mehr explained. The following Machina video shows how the RoboCraftsman system, guided by the inputs, forms the metal to craft the airframe. This avoids having to use equipment like dies and rolls, dramatically speeding the process and allowing production at scale, Mehr stated. “Basically, the agentic AI agents can explore and generate whole different versions of an airframe with different parameters,” Mehr proffered. “Because now it’s parameterized, you can just change the parameters and you get another airframe, and then evaluate if that airframe is good for the requirement they want.” This way, the RoboCraftsman system “can easily generate 20, 30, 40, 50 different designs just in software, and then put it through simulations to figure out which one actually meets the requirement for that,” the Machina CEO added. “The concept is that we’re going to bring this capability closer to the point of need, so that you can build a different requirement for let’s say PACOM versus U.S. CENTCOM versus in Ukraine,” Mehr said. “They can easily switch and build a drone that they need.” Low-cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) drones in the U.S. Central Command region. (CENTCOM) (U.S. Central Command Public Affairs) Under this contract, each Edge Factory will consist of one or two RoboCraftsman cells and each cell can make a LUCAS airframe in two to five days, depending on the size, Mehr said. A scaled deployment of 10 or more cells would take place under a new contract, he added. The systems can make “anywhere from a one-off all the way to the thousands, sometimes tens of thousands,” Mehr said. It all depends on the number of RoboCraftsman systems that are ordered. At the moment, Mehr envisions that each 12-foot airframe will cost “somewhere around $15,000 to $40,000,” depending on the complexity. This range is a relatively common price point for Russian Shahed-136 variants and U.S. knockoffs under the LUCAS program. The company has already produced a six-foot, half-scale airframe that was recently tested at Edwards Air Force Base, said Mehr. However, that initial test proved problematic. “The first design had some challenges with crosswind mitigation,” Mehr told us. “Since then, we have moved the location of the engine slightly to enable better crosswind mitigation, and now we’re running again. And the beauty is for us to go from one design to the next is just like a couple of months, a maximum of three months. Like we can just then try it again.” A six-foot, half-scale LUCAS drone, made by a Machina RoboCraftsman system, being tested at Edwards Air Force Base, California. (Machina) Mehr said that Machina is not working with SpektreWorks, which designed and made the LUCAS drones previously supplied to the U.S. military and already used in combat. SpektreWorks declined to comment. The Edge Factory contract is one of several Machina has been awarded to use these systems to help build and repair military hardware. In July, Machina was issued a qualification contract by Lockheed Martin to produce fuel tanks for AGM-158 Joint Air-To-Surface Standoff Missiles (JASSM). That plan called for the creation of a 200,000-square-foot facility “designed to house up to 50 RoboCraftsman cells and support high-rate production of mission-critical metal structures for defense programs including JASSM,” according to a media release at the time . “By integrating forming, machining, welding, and assembly under one roof, Machina Factory 3 compresses production timelines from months to days.” “Lockheed Martin Ventures invested in Machina Labs for its powerful combination of speed, flexibility, and scalability, and our teams have worked closely to transition key capabilities to production,” said Chris Moran, vice president and general manager, Lockheed Martin Ventures. “Machina’s work advances capacity, reduces risk, and helps ensure we can deliver mission-critical capabilities at scale. We congratulate Machina on this milestone as a supplier, which further strengthens an innovative and resilient American Defense Industrial Base.” U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. Seth Blackwood, 363rd Training Squadron Aircraft Armament instructor, directs the installation of an AGM-158 JASSM onto a B-52 during a Combat Capability Demonstration April 16, 2024, at Sheppard Air Force Base, Texas. (U.S. Air Force photo by Rachel Ross) Rachel Ross Earlier this year, a Machina RoboCraftsman platform helped repair a C-17 Globemaster III cargo jet that was damaged during a tornado, Mehr told us. The system “fabricated a first-of-its-kind replacement part for the damaged C-17 without the need for dedicated tooling,” the company noted . “Machina deployed a RoboCraftsman at the RSO [ Rapid Sustainment Office ], where production for a left nose panel began in March 2026 and was completed in May 2026. The aircraft returned to flight on July 30, 2026 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio.” Damage to a C-17 Globemaster III cargo jet caused by a tornado that was eventually repaired with a Machina RoboCraftsman system. (Machina) We asked the Pentagon for information about why they selected Machina and their metrics for success, but we have not heard back yet. Pentagon Pushing For Deployable Manufacturing The U.S. military has been pushing for several years for the employment of mobile additive and other forms of advanced manufacturing “to produce unmanned aircraft components in remote or austere environments and reduce dependence on traditional supply chains,” the Air Force’s innovation arm, AFWERX, noted last month . The idea is to place these systems in a wide array of locations, produce the quantity needed and tailor the airframe for the mission. In one such case, the Air National Guard and Air Force Special Operations Command partnered with the San Diego-based Firestorm company in 2023 “to create an expeditionary assembly unit capable of mass-producing unmanned aerial systems,” according to the Pentagon . The result was called an Expeditionary Manufacturing Cell or xCell. “It’s basically an expeditionary 3D printer,” Master Sgt. Richard Stone, 194th Air Support Operations Group innovation officer, explained at the time. “The basis of the technology is … it’s about the size of a [shipping container] and it can print out, for this specific use case, drones.” “Inside this [shipping container], it’ll print out all the components,” said Stone “But then you have what’s called RPA, which is robotic process [automation.]” The xCell “prints the individual pieces and then uses RPA to assemble the major components of the drone,” the Pentagon added. A render of Expeditionary Manufacturing Cell or xCell which is capable of mass-producing unmanned aerial systems. Theoretically, xCell can be hidden in plain sight while running on local resources to 3D-print items on the battle field. (Courtesy photo from Firestorm) 194th Wing “The user can take these components and, almost like Legos, put them together,” said Stone. “So if you want a longer drone with a specific payload, you can take those components and put them together and the computer will tell you, ‘This is where the wings go and this is where the center of gravity should be.” The company went on to produce Tempest drones that were flying with 3rd Littoral Combat Team, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, during Exercise Balikatan 2026 at Cagayan North International Airport in the Philippines, AFWERX noted. A Firestorm Tempest Drone with 3rd Littoral Combat Team, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, is staged for preflight checks during Exercise Balikatan 2026 at Cagayan North International Airport, Lal-Lo, Philippines, April 23, 2026. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Ernesto Lagunes) Cpl. Ernesto Lagunes Our own Jamie Hunter recently interviewed Craig Anders, senior vice president of growth at Aevex, about the company’s ForgeX containerized 3D drone printing system . The ForgeX system “represents being able to take the fight further forward, print drones on demand, print them out towards the front of the lines, cut down the logistics trail, and absolutely revolutionize the battlefield,” said Anders.  The goal is to be “able to kick these planes out the door on short timelines to go out and get the missions done, work within the local area to make sure that the mission can be accomplished by any means necessary,” he added. Anders said the ForgeX printers fabricate three types of drones, the Vandal , Onyx and Raker . He added that the system can produce up to 880 a year. Growing U.S. Reliance On LUCAS The U.S. military first announced it had begun fielding LUCAS, which was reverse-engineered from the Iranian-designed Shahed-136 , in December 2025. This came just months after TWZ laid out a detailed case for why the U.S. military should start acquiring Shahed-136 clones in large volumes. LUCAS made its official combat debut in the opening phases of major combat operations against Iran earlier this year. The pusher-propeller, combustion-engine-powered kamikaze drones were first launched from the ground, a U.S. official told us at the time. They can also be fired from ships. In March, CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper told us the LUCAS drones were “indispensable. ” The following video shows Cooper answering our question about the LUCAS drones. CENTCOM Commander Brad Cooper on LUCAS: LUCAS is indispensable. pic.twitter.com/VaLXmjawA6 — Clash Report (@clashreport) March 5, 2026 Now the Army is looking to expand the use of these weapons to the Pacific, Maj. Gen. Bernard Harrington, head of the 7th Infantry Division, told us during the Association of the U.S. Army (AUSA) conference last month. “So we see that playing a key role in order to be able to achieve that effect at mass, … [and] in an affordable manner, while also being able potentially to preserve something that’s more exquisite for something that requires an exquisite munition.” “So as we start modeling out what it looks like to be able to penetrate a portion of the anti-access/area denial network in support of the joint task force in the PACOM [U.S. Pacific Command] area of operations, we started looking at, well, how do I bend – how do I achieve mass at a cost curve?” the 7th Infantry and MDC-PAC commander explained. “What effect am I really trying to achieve on a system in order to provide that window of opportunity for that joint force commander?” A map showing Chinese military outposts in the Spratly Islands at the southern end of the South China Sea. This gives a good sense of the anti-access/area denial bubbles that China has already established and continues to expand upon. (DOD) “So maybe I don’t necessarily need to sink a ship, but if I take out certain systems on that vessel, well then it creates this temporal window opportunity,” he continued. “Then that joint force commander can surge in that carrier strike group or bomber task force.” While the exact details of the LUCAS program requirements have been hard to pin down, it’s likely that multiple drone types from multiple manufacturers could become part of the program as time goes on. Ed Mehr gave us an idea of what that could look like: “Shahed clearly inspired LUCAS, which stands for Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System. But we shouldn’t confuse the inspiration with the destination. The future isn’t about mass-producing replicas of one drone. Different theaters and missions demand different performance, and therefore different designs. That could mean a LUCAS-style drone or a wide variety of Group 2 and Group 3 unmanned aircraft. The real breakthrough is making that diversity affordable. We’re developing flexible manufacturing technologies that can produce many different designs cost-effectively using one of the cheapest and most proven aerospace materials: sheet metal. It’s what aircraft have been built from for generations. We’re bringing it into an era where manufacturing can adapt as quickly as the mission.” We won’t know how the Machina contract ultimately pans out until sometime in mid-2028. Regardless, given the importance of both the LUCAS drones and deployable, additive and advanced manufacturing are becoming, this is likely a first step in what could be a whole new logistics concept that could underpin a significant portion of the growing LUCAS program. Contact the author: howard@twz.com The post LUCAS Drones To Be Built In Containerized Robotic Micro Factories Designed To Be Forward Deployed appeared first on TWZ .
